lines.sentence: The noises of the drinking hole echo off the walls as the door opens and a new patron enters the estate.

Welcome into the String of Life, sir! You’re one of the early ones, we just opened up a little while ago. Unfortunately we have live storytelling planned today, but not until the evening. My name is Laurel. May I present you with food or-
Wine? Your finest if you would. The roads have been long, and the company has not been appealing. My name is Bruster, miss. Thank you for your hospitality.

Wine? We hold a lot of drinks, but wine has been running a little low recently due to its popularity. I guess a lot of people have been moving by with the preference for it. Let me check to see if I have a bottle left.
Sounds like many with taste, if I may. I typically make my own, but I’ve heard tales of a festival happening in town soon and wanted to participate, so I’ve rooted myself in a nearby inn.

Ah! I have 2 bottles left. One for you and one for the next person lucky enough to ask. Did I hear that you make your own? You must own a vinery then! I’ve heard that the process for making it involves a lot of waiting.

You could say I created it! More than enough patience for a good drink. Ooo. You were right, this is much better than most glasses I’ve tasted from hands other than my own! It’s got a strong aftertaste though.
…What is that? It’s not unappealing, but it’s certainly powerful-
Are you talking about the drink? I don’t make most of the drinks myself, I mainly serve the customers. While I have you here though-
Laurel’s stance wavers a bit as she becomes dizzy. No wind up, just a headache as the tavern starts to spin in her view.
No, not the drink, something else here…
The taverna doors clatter open as a familiar bard loudly steps into the room.

Miss Laurel, Miss Laurel! I saw her again! She has been protecting my travels! Oh you should have seen her Miss Laurel she was beautiful! The meaning of everything I stand for incarnated into a Goddess!
The Goddess of Stories believes in what I’ve been sharing to the people of this land!… Oh I’m sorry for inter-
Ahhhhh. A Goddess huh? So that’s what this is.
Slowly, more and more people start to populate the String of Life. Something is wrong with them though. Stand. Fight.
